classical-e2e-fixtures-incompatible-with.closure_condition: Inventory the 16 affected E2E scripts as retained or retired. Every retained path must obtain deterministic PQ initial validators from one shared helper, boot a real PQ chain in branch CI, and exercise its advertised route; this includes localnet-jsonrpc.py and its TOSCAN consumer. Retired paths must be removed from release claims and entry-point inventories rather than left executable but dead.
classical-e2e-fixtures-incompatible-with.observation: Sixteen E2E scripts contain 17 make_initial_validator() call sites. Production manager admission refuses those classical descriptors on the PQ consensus path, completes synchronization with zero validating groups, and never reaches masterchain seqno 1. The only default wallet/transfer integration used the same dead setup until it was converted to PQ validators. No branch CI job boots a chain: build-tos-linux-x86-64-shared.yml declares on.push.branches=[main], while tosctl-service.yml declares jobs.real-chain-explorer.if as github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' (observed skipped on run 35748202781).
